prespecified_interpretation: HMMA practical positive authorizes at most a two-profile H12 multi-sequence scoped prior; it does not authorize all packed shapes.
HMMA non-positive narrows the Round 1 observation toward a skew/max-chunks-conditioned prior.
A second tcgen05 negative rejects the two exact virtual-152 mixed schedulers; the second-wave explanation remains a hypothesis because CTA count and stride change together.
A tcgen05 reversal records a head/stride interaction and blocks transfer of the H64 negative prior.
Neither result identifies the pure causal effect of the HMMA or tcgen05 opcode family.
